archetypes.name: dyn-baseline-provenance
archetypes.rationale: Live vs frozen baseline provenance and merge-base failure paths are easy to get wrong.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect resolve_baseline, touched_paths_since_baseline, and frozen-fallback provenance in scope_disposition.py. Confirm unresolved remote HEAD never attributes baseline..HEAD churn, valid remote HEAD with failed merge-base raises ShipError, and FORKED_TARGET precedence uses ship-pr-state.sh over session-env.sh without ambient env. Check path-state signature retention after clean-tree commit and pruning after revert. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
